integrity: Reproducible analytic formulas with a Python-standard-library finite verification script; no independent audit or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact statement applies to a uniform nonatomic two-resource game with linear affinity subsidy and independent Gumbel choice shocks.
Finite checks do not certify limiting results; an explicit analytic proof is supplied.
Broader potential-game and noisy-selection literature could contain an unindexed equivalent; close papers inaccessible in full are identified in the review.
title: Exponential bias selection from a continuum of two-resource equilibria
